CREATE TABLE semio_kit_representation (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, document_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES semio_kit_document(id), ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0), type_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES semio_kit_type(id), target_reference_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES semio_kit_reference(id), pin_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (pin_kind IN ('head','checkpoint','snapshot')), checkpoint_id TEXT, blob_id INTEGER REFERENCES semio_kit_blob(id));
CREATE TABLE semio_kit_blob (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, hash TEXT NOT NULL, size TEXT NOT NULL, media_type TEXT NOT NULL);
